note: an amqps:// URI makes the oracle's amqp-client (shaded 5.x, ConnectionFactory.setUri -> useSslProtocol()) use the JVM default SSL context: the image's cacerts and nothing else (the image sets no javax.net.ssl.trustStore; KeyStoreFactory, which sets one, is unreachable from the server), with hostname verification. Dialing this server's own port, whose leaf MockServer's CA signs, the client refuses the certificate: the server logs the client's certificate_unknown alert and the load fails as an unexpected error. An IP literal: the client resolves a host name to all its addresses (DnsRecordIpAddressResolver), shuffles them and tries each, and localhost's ::1 reaches only a dual-stack listener (follow-up of 0715). The oracle cannot then write the log as LOG_ENTRIES, the JSSE cause chain failing Jackson (asyncapi_tls_untrusted_log_entries)

steps.note: AMQP over TLS to this server's own port by IP: the client does not trust MockServer's CA

the log: the server's handshake failure (the client's certificate_unknown alert) and the load's unexpected exception (the two race: the server's event loop logs the alert while the client's failure ends the load, in either order)

mask.reason: the load's body names the server's port, whose digit count differs between the oracle and replay
